attributes.name: Iron Golem
attributes.powers:
The Iron Golem is immune to the Attack and Mental traits.

Before the encounter, the Golem deals 1d4-1 damage to a random character at this location. Roll 1d4 for the type of damage:

1. Cold

2. Electricity

3. Fire

4. Ranged Combat

corrections.corrected_text: On the monsters Clay Golem and Iron Golem, change "You may not play spells with the Attack trait" to "The [Clay Golem | Iron Golem] is immune to the Attack and Mental traits".
corrections.issue: Should the Clay Golem or Iron Golem be affected by items that have the Attack trait?
